_comment_backbone: Same substitution as experiments/spair_vgg16.json: SwinV2-L replaced by the plain VGG16 of SplineCNN/DGMC (relu4_2 + relu5_1 = 512 + 512 channels), so this run is comparable both to the NMT SPair-71k sweep and to the DGMC PascalVOC numbers. IMAGE_SIZE 256 is the DGMC/ThinkMatch setting and also rescales the edge pseudo-coordinates in utils/build_graphs.py.
_comment_batch_size: BATCH_SIZE is deliberately NOT overridden here. voc_basic.json sets 8, which is NMT's own PascalVOC recipe; the claim being tested is that only the SplineConv layer changes, so the host recipe is left alone. spair_vgg16.json sets 5 because no author-provided SPair recipe existed.
_comment_paths: ROOT_DIR must end in a slash: data/pascal_voc.py builds the image and annotation directories by string concatenation (cfg.VOC2011.ROOT_DIR + 'JPEGImages'). SET_SPLIT points at the split shipped with the shared PascalVOC tree; see NMT_VOC_ROOT in hpc/env.sh for why voc2011_pairs.npz is not required.
_comment_cache: data/pascal_voc.py writes a filtered-xml pickle to cfg.CACHE_PATH. The default 'data/cache' is repo-relative, i.e. inside the 50 GB HOME quota, and group storage is read-only inside jobs, so it is redirected to scratch.

TRAIN._comment_epochs: Identical budget to the SPair-71k sweep so the two NMT columns are comparable: lr_schedule long_halving5 defines 12 epochs, max_epochs stops after 7, and both LR drops (epochs 2 and 5) still happen.
